Test Case: Verify rejected role is restricted for re-application
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login,1. User applies for Role A in a team.2. Team leader rejects the request.3. User navigates again to Apply/Join page for the same team.4. Check availability of Role A.
Expected Result: Rejected Role A should be disabled or restricted for that user. User should not be able to reapply for the same rejected role.

Test Case: Verify other available roles remain selectable after rejection
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. User is rejected for Role A.2. Navigate to Apply page again.3. Check availability of Role B or other roles.4. Attempt to apply for another role.
Expected Result: Other available roles should remain selectable. User should be able to successfully apply for a different role within the same team.

Test Case: Verify rejected role displays proper validation messaging
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. After rejection, attempt to select the same rejected role (if clickable).2. Attempt to submit application.
Expected Result: System should display validation message such as “You have already been rejected for this role” or relevant message.

Test Case: Verify restriction applies only to the specific rejected role
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. User gets rejected for Role A.2. Check availability of other roles.3. Attempt to apply for another role.4. Verify team access.
Expected Result: Only Role A should be restricted. Other roles should function normally without blocking team application.

Test Case: Verify behavior when multiple roles are rejected separately
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. Apply and get rejected for Role A.2. Apply and get rejected for Role B.3. Navigate to Apply page again.4. Check role availability.
Expected Result: Roles A and B should be restricted. Any remaining available roles should remain selectable.

Test Case: Verify re-application works after role capacity changes
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. User rejected for Role A.2. Another member leaves Role A (capacity becomes available).3. User revisits Apply page.
Expected Result: Even if capacity becomes available, previously rejected role should remain restricted for that specific user unless system rules allow reset.

Test Case: Verify role restriction persists across sessions
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. User is rejected for Role A.2. Logout.3. Login again.4. Navigate to Apply page.
Expected Result: Rejected role should remain restricted across sessions. System should maintain rejection history.

Test Case: Verify backend validation prevents bypassing rejected role restriction
Steps: Navigate to https://frontend-qa-849641690736.asia-south1.run.app/login.1. Inspect rejected role element via browser DevTools.2. Attempt to enable and submit application manually.3. Observe system response.
Expected Result: Backend validation should prevent application for rejected role even if UI is manipulated. Application should not be accepted.
